title: Demon Wind Shuriken
body:
Syntax: demon wind shuriken <target>

Description: Throws one carried Demon Wind Shuriken, which lands on the room floor and can cause bleeding. Requires a carried demon wind shuriken. Base damage: 91-107. 35% chance to inflict bleeding. Bukijutsu unlocks at level 35. Costs 20 Chakra and 22 Stamina; 7 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
